reviews.body: We try to avoid a generic array shape. Can we turn it into a DTO so we know shape of the array items of logprobs?

comments.body:
Thanks @iBotPeaches — updated: `logprobs` is now a list of typed DTOs (`OutputMessageContentOutputTextLogprob`, with `OutputMessageContentOutputTextTopLogprob` for `top_logprobs`) instead of a generic array shape. `toArray()` round-trips the payload; absent stays null. PR description updated to match.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
